picks.editorial_note: An AI system reportedly produced a partial analytic proof and formal Lean verification toward the Navier-Stokes Millennium Prize Problem using thousands of coordinated autonomous agents — a landmark demonstration of AI contributing to unsolved frontier mathematics, not just assisting with known techniques.
picks.title: Solução de problema matemático: como a IA está impactando a ciência? - Jornal da Unicamp

picks.editorial_note: CERN's strategic partnership with Mistral to build a foundation model trained on billions of simulated particle collisions marks one of the most significant alliances yet between a major AI company and a flagship international science facility.
picks.title: CERN and Mistral join forces to accelerate AI for science – Home

picks.editorial_note: DOE's Genesis Mission, discussed at the National Academy of Engineering meeting, links national supercomputers, datasets, and experimental facilities into a coordinated federal AI-for-discovery initiative — a signal of how AI is being woven into the core of national scientific infrastructure.
picks.title: NAE Annual Meeting Spotlights DOE’s New Genesis Project and Other AI Initiatives Aimed at Advancing Discovery

picks.editorial_note: A White House-announced regional computing consortium bringing together 14+ universities to build shared advanced AI infrastructure represents a major coordinated push to scale academic computing capacity for AI research.
picks.title: Vanderbilt among founding members of Southeast Regional SI Computing Consortium

picks.editorial_note: A $28.6 million federally funded, multi-institution effort to apply machine learning to protein misfolding in neurodegenerative disease shows AI moving into high-stakes biomedical research with real translational potential.
picks.title: Brown scholar to play key role in federally funded project to prevent neurodegenerative disease

picks.editorial_note: A $20 million NSF-led project to build a robot-controlled, AI-enhanced cloud laboratory for discovering quantum materials exemplifies how AI and automation are accelerating the pace of physical science discovery.
picks.title: Robots and AI Could Speed Search for Quantum Materials

picks.editorial_note: A $19.2 million, five-year Army Research Office award to advance AI-driven computational imaging and optical sensing underscores deepening ties between academic AI research and national defense priorities.
picks.title: UCF-Led Team Receives $19.2 Million Army Research Office Award to Advance the Science of Light

picks.editorial_note: Georgia Tech's work on detecting internal warning signs of unsafe AI behavior, motivated by a real incident of AI deception during testing, speaks directly to urgent AI safety and governance concerns shaping policy debates.
picks.title: Can We Detect Harmful AI Before It’s Too Late? Researchers Search for Warning Signs

picks.editorial_note: ASU's new AI Research Acceleration Platform, backed by an Intel donation, democratizes access to advanced AI supercomputing for all students and researchers — a notable industry-academia model for broadening AI research capacity.
picks.title: ASU provides access to AI-supercomputing for all

picks.editorial_note: Louisiana's bid to become an AI-driven energy hub, anchored by up to $250 billion in planned investment including major data center and spaceport projects, illustrates the scale of capital now flowing into AI infrastructure and its ripple effects on regional economies.
picks.title: Large tech firms, small startups and universities are fueling Louisiana’s bid to become the energy hub of tomorrow
